capabilities.name: Logic wafer fabrication
capabilities.definition: Domestic processing of logic CMOS wafers at a documented node. Advanced-node production and equipment independence are separate assessments.

capabilities.name: Chip assembly and test
capabilities.definition: Domestic semiconductor package assembly and testing, including captive integrated-device-manufacturer operations.

capabilities.name: Lithography equipment
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture of semiconductor lithography exposure systems, including mature-node and packaging tools. Tool use and imports do not establish tool manufacture.

capabilities.name: CNC machine tools
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture and assembly of commercial CNC metal-cutting machines. Controllers and critical components have separate supply-chain assessments.

capabilities.name: Precision spindles
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture of precision machine-tool spindle units. Rebuilding and distribution alone do not establish new-spindle manufacture.

capabilities.name: Electronic photoresists
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture of photo-patternable resist formulations for semiconductor, MEMS or electronic processing. EUV-resist formulations are a separate scope.

capabilities.name: High-purity process gases
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture or purification of high-purity gases for electronic-device processing. Evidence is scoped to the identified gas species.

capabilities.name: Active pharmaceutical ingredients
capabilities.definition: Active pharmaceutical ingredients produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Biologics production
capabilities.definition: Biologics production produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Aero-engine hot sections
capabilities.definition: Aero-engine hot sections produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Aircraft structures
capabilities.definition: Aircraft structures produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Vehicle powertrains
capabilities.definition: Vehicle powertrains produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Automotive electronics
capabilities.definition: Automotive electronics produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Specialty steel
capabilities.definition: Specialty steel produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Nickel superalloys
capabilities.definition: Nickel superalloys produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Industrial robot integration
capabilities.definition: Domestic engineering, build and commissioning of integrated robotic manufacturing cells. The origin of robot arms and critical components is assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Precision robot reducers
capabilities.definition: Domestic design and manufacture of precision robot-joint reduction gearboxes. Limited product offers and repeat manufacture carry different thresholds.

capabilities.name: Battery cells
capabilities.definition: Battery cells produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Cathode materials
capabilities.definition: Cathode materials produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Solar modules
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture of solar modules. Cell, wafer and polysilicon origin require separate assessment.

capabilities.name: Grid transformers
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture and testing of grid power or distribution transformers.

capabilities.name: Precision casting
capabilities.definition: Precision casting produced at an operating domestic facility. Ownership and domestic value-add are assessed separately.

capabilities.name: Dimensional metrology
capabilities.definition: Domestic manufacture of CMMs or other dimensional-metrology and precision-gauging equipment. Imported sensors and software are assessed separately.
